svg.text: 69 breakthroughs under eight factors, plus the Contact Clause beside the equation. Each box shows the chance the node resolves before 2071 / 2095 / ever, given what it depends on. Arrows run from a dependency to the node that needs it.
Numbers reviewed by outside models (roadmap step 27, ruled 2026-09-19, landed 2026-09-20); they move at the weekly scan, the quarterly scan and the annual review.
Headline, A2 (works off earth on rotation): baseline 0.4% · moderate 1.1% · strong 3.5% · radical 11% · open 14%
T3 (Slow Expanse, the bar for the Belt existing): baseline 0.6% · moderate 1.7% · strong 5.0% · radical 16% · open 23%

Scenarios are the year the window closes: baseline 2071, moderate 2080, strong 2095, radical 2136, open = no deadline. Computed from 20,000 play-throughs per scenario with the world draw at its default spread.
Leaves: could resolve within five years
Dashed outline: a choice John makes, never rolled. Filled: already resolved.
